```{r}
library(terra)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(stars)
library(sf)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(spDataLarge)
```


```{r}
# Read in the data
v05_7 <- stars::read_stars(here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif"))
v05_16 <- stars::read_stars(here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif"))
v06_7 <- stars::read_stars(here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif"))
v06_16 <- stars::read_stars(here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif"))

roads <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg")) |> 
    clean_names()

buildings <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg")) |> 
    clean_names()
```


```{r}
# Merge rasters for same date
houston_07 <- st_mosaic(v05_7, v06_7) # 2021-02-07
houston_16 <- st_mosaic(v05_16, v06_16) # 2021-02-16
```


```{r}
# Check if all dataframe's CRSs match
st_crs(roads) == st_crs(buildings)
st_crs(houston_07) == st_crs(houston_16)
st_crs(houston_07) == st_crs(buildings)
```
